status: Sampling declared before acquiring tweet contents; labels and candidate predictions absent.

source.access_scope: Published research dataset released by authors; retain MIT repository notice and cite Xu & Cohen ACL 2018. Third-party tweet rights are not authenticated; no public redistribution or platform rehydration is performed.

selection.sampling_rule: Take the first 200 unique post IDs and whitespace/case-normalized target/text pairs in chronological timestamp/ID order from author-released raw NVDA daily files in 2015. Read daily files in ascending date order until 200 eligible unique posts; retain every selected original post including ambiguity, neutral, URL-only and irrelevant posts for explicit AI exclusion. Do not select using candidate predictions, later returns or sentiment tags. Skip records with missing ID, text or explicit timestamp and retain a preparation log.
selection.access_conditions_reference: ../../deliverables/stocknet_source_access.json; retained original repository README and LICENSE in sources/stocknet
